statements.statement: The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
